_note: THIS factory's declared boundary for the issue-receipt clause (issue #529), read by tests/test_commit_subject_issue_refs.py. `marker` is the day the gate lands: from it onward, a commit whose AUTHOR date is greater than the marker, and whose subject cites an issue the ledger CLOSED before that author date, must itself add a ledger row whose subject names that issue. The clause is FORWARD-ONLY by design — a history-wide form is permanently red, and a gate nobody can green is a gate the next lane learns to ignore. MEASURED over the full history at 2026-11-04T00:35:41Z — 3576 commits, 524 closed issues, author-date predicate, last-close-wins: 188 RED commits making 201 RED pairs. The ladder falls to 29 commits after 2026-10-21T07:17:02Z, 11 after 2026-10-25, 6 after 2026-10-27, 5 after 2026-11-02, 1 after 2026-11-03, 1 after 2026-11-04T00:00:00Z. Nothing before the marker is backfilled (n=1596): those are history, not a backlog. The marker is NOT an exemption, and the ladder is recorded here so a reader sees what the boundary excludes and can judge the choice instead of assuming it. ALL SIX exemptions are POST-marker violations, so they are debt and not forgiveness: each repair space is empty — the commit is pushed, a revert cannot clear a gate that reads history, and moving the marker past any of them would make this file's own sentence false. The second is a CAUSAL citation — a subject naming a settled issue as the CAUSE of the work rather than as a unit it settles, which owes no receipt in substance — filed as #616. The last four are ONE incident, not four: the Triage lane's continuation of #627 in the 5 to 51 minutes after its close row n=4856, where the follow-on work found a SECOND defect while finishing the first, and the only identifier available for it was the unit just closed. That is the case #616's writer rule could not describe, so #616 now carries its second half: follow-on work cites a FRESH issue, opened when the follow-on is discovered, and the candidate rule 'do not close a unit while work on it is in flight' is REJECTED because the closer cannot know what the next commit will discover. The deciding metric, named as the ladder requires, is enforceability at the writer's own boundary. The class's remedy remains a writer rule (causation in the commit BODY, which this gate never reads) rather than a predicate change.
